sections.content: This integration increases efficiency by providing a holistic understanding of the borrower’s journey (initial outreach, up to closing). Creating a bridge between your CRM and your mortgage software programs (e.g., Encompass, Blend, Byte) also improves compliance tracking and client experience. Overall, in a growing lending market, moving your mortgage business forward must include this integration.
